summary.name: Clinical Grouped Bar Chart.step
summary.description: Creates a clustered/grouped bar chart showing incidence of a response by time and cohort. Converted from the Custom Task 'Injection Site Reaction'.

summary.name: Clinical Profile Graph with Discrete Axes.step
summary.description: Creates a median/mean profile plot with confidence limits by visit and treatment group on a discrete X axis. Converted from the Custom Task 'Lipid Profile'.

summary.name: Clinical Waterfall Graph.step
summary.description: Creates a waterfall graph showing change in tumor size (or any change-from-baseline measure) by treatment/response group. Converted from the Custom Task 'Change in Tumor Size Graph'.
